              Students will:
(1)	Learn a wider range of modeling and rndering algorithms.
(2)	Learn a wider range of animation methods.
(3)	Learn how to create 3D CG animations.
(4)     Learn how to create digital contents for projection mapping.
(5)     Learn and practice projection mapping.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              Students are required to install 3D CG software of Blender on their computer.
